page.overview:
Who is Cryshale?

Cryshale (クリシェール) is a recurring boss enemy in the Chocobo series. He is the final boss of Chocobo no Fushigina Dungeon where he first debuted. Since then, he has repeated the role of a boss enemy in all his appearances.

Atla and Poulet encounter a chocobo villager, Camilla's Pa, that is posseded by an evil amethyst. This chocobo traps Poulet into a mysterious dungeon that Poulet must traverse. After reaching the deepest parts of the dungeon, Poulet confronts the possessed chocobo and manages to free him from the crystal's possession, but the amethyst then posses Atla and takes his Cryshale form in response to Atla's greedy desires. However, Clair, who had been disguised as a White Mage, saves Atla, which forces Cryshale to fight Poulet. Poulet successfully destroys Cryshale's newly created body.

After Atla and Poulet leave the village, the amethyst lands by the wayside and possesses an inanimate scarecrow.

Cryshale also re-appears as an optional boss in the extra third dungeon at the 100 floor, where he has become far stronger, even more than Shinryu and Omega.
